description: Agent-to-user communication. Renders in the middle down of the page. Use 'question' mode to ask a free-text question. Use 'feedback' mode to provide status updates, analysis, or decisions. Supports element anchoring (e.g. 'w:15') and presentation styles ('observation', 'decision', 'warning', 'question').

anchor.description: Optional element Ref ID (e.g. 'w:15') or CSS selector to visually anchor this thought to on the page.

app.description: Optional Electron app name. (Note: thought HUD overlay is browser-only).

input.description: Input field type for question mode (default: sentence).

message.description: The question to ask, or the feedback/analysis to log.

style.description: Thought presentation style. Defaults to 'observation' for feedback and 'question' for question.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for question mode before auto-cancel (default: 120).

name: browser_thoughts
